userStories.title: Create /app/biomechanics/page.tsx route
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Route exists at /biomechanics, renders without errors, uses 'use client' directive, basic layout with placeholder content

userStories.title: Create types/biomechanics.ts with TypeScript interfaces
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Interfaces defined: MotionData, ActivationData, ForceData, BiomechanicsState. All types exported. No TypeScript errors.

userStories.title: Create lib/store/biomechanics-store.ts Zustand store
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Store created with state: motionData, activationData, forceData, showHeatmap, showForces, playback state. Actions for loading data and toggling visualization. Uses selector pattern like viewer-store.ts.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/BiomechanicsScene.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders R3F Canvas with OrbitControls and Environment. Connects to biomechanics-store. Follows existing Scene.tsx patterns.

userStories.title: Add basic layout with Canvas and placeholder panels
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Page has layout: top toolbar placeholder, main 3D viewport, bottom timeline placeholder, side settings placeholder. Responsive design with Tailwind.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/TimelineControls.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders timeline bar with play button, slider, time display, speed selector. Uses shadcn/ui Slider and Button components.

userStories.title: Implement play/pause button with Space keyboard shortcut
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Play/pause toggles isPlaying in store. Space bar toggles playback. Button shows correct icon (Play/Pause). Accessible with aria-label.

userStories.title: Implement timeline slider with frame scrubbing
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Slider value syncs with currentTime in store. Dragging updates time. Animation mixer responds to time changes. Smooth scrubbing without jitter.

userStories.title: Implement speed selector (0.25x-2x)
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown with speed options: 0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x. Selection updates playbackSpeed in store. Animation respects speed setting.

userStories.title: Add time display in MM:SS.ms format
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Shows current time and total duration. Format: 01:23.45 / 02:00.00. Updates in real-time during playback. Monospace font for stability.

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/bvh-parser.ts using THREE.BVHLoader
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parser loads BVH files using three/examples/jsm/loaders/BVHLoader. Returns skeleton and animation clip. Handles parse errors gracefully with Result pattern.

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/csv-parser.ts for motion data
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parses CSV with columns: time, joint, x, y, z, rx, ry, rz. Converts to MotionData interface. Validates required columns. Error messages for malformed data.

userStories.title: Create lib/parsers/activation-parser.ts for muscle data
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Parses JSON activation data with version, muscles array, framerate, frames. Validates schema. Normalizes activation values to 0-1 range.

userStories.title: Create hooks/use-biomechanics-loader.ts hook
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Hook handles file input, detects format (BVH/CSV/JSON), calls appropriate parser, updates store. Returns isLoading, error states. Follows use-gltf-loader.ts pattern.

userStories.title: Add drag-and-drop file upload UI
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Drop zone accepts BVH, CSV, JSON files. Visual feedback on drag over. Shows file name after load. Error toast for unsupported formats. Click to browse option.

userStories.title: Create lib/colormaps/index.ts with viridis, cividis, etc.
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Exports colormap functions: viridis, cividis, inferno, plasma. Each takes 0-1 value, returns THREE.Color. Perceptually uniform interpolation.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/MuscleHeatmap.tsx with vertex colors
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Component applies activation values as vertex colors to mesh. Uses selected colormap from store. Updates colors each frame during playback. Performance: <1ms per frame.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/ActivationLegend.tsx
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Shows gradient bar with 0-1 scale labels. Matches current colormap. Positioned in corner of viewport. Toggle visibility from settings. Accessible color contrast.

userStories.title: Create components/biomechanics/ForceVectors.tsx with ArrowHelper
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Renders force vectors as arrows using THREE.ArrowHelper. Length scales with magnitude. Direction matches force data. Configurable scale factor. Toggle visibility.

userStories.title: Sync visualization updates with timeline playback
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Heatmap and force vectors update in useFrame. Interpolate between keyframes if needed. Smooth transitions. No visual glitches during scrubbing.

userStories.title: Create hooks/use-url-state.ts with lz-string compression
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Hook encodes state object to compressed URL parameter. Decodes on mount. Uses lz-string compressToEncodedURIComponent. Handles missing/invalid params gracefully.

userStories.title: Implement URL state encoding for camera, time, speed
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: URL updates when camera moves, time changes, or speed changes. Debounced to avoid excessive history entries. State schema versioned for future compatibility.

userStories.title: Implement URL state restoration on page load
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: On mount, parse URL params and restore: camera position/target, current time, playback speed, visualization toggles. Smooth transition to restored state.

userStories.title: Add Copy Link button with toast notification
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: Button in toolbar copies current URL to clipboard. Shows success toast. Uses navigator.clipboard API. Fallback for older browsers. Accessible button with icon.

userStories.title: Final integration test, performance verification, accessibility check
userStories.acceptanceCriteria: All features work together. TypeScript compiles clean. ESLint passes. 60fps maintained. <100 draw calls. Keyboard navigation works. Screen reader compatible. WCAG AA contrast.
